title: Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes for a weekend breakfast.
notes: Do not overmix the batter; a few lumps are fine.
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, and baking powder together.
Whisk in the eggs and milk until just combined.
Ladle batter onto a hot, lightly buttered pan and cook until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip and cook until golden, then serve warm.

title: Greek Salad
description: Tomatoes, cucumber, olives, and feta with lemon and oregano.
steps: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber, and olives in a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice, sprinkle with oregano, and toss.
Top with the feta and serve.
